# azion_workload_deployment (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_workload_deployment" "example" {
  workload_id   = "12345"
  deployment_id = "67890"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) Numeric identifier of the Deployment.
- `workload_id` (String) Numeric identifier of the Workload.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Status of the deployment.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the deployment.
- `current` (Boolean) Whether this is the current deployment.
- `id` (Number) The deployment identifier.
- `last_editor` (String) The last editor of the deployment.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp of the deployment.
- `name` (String) Name of the deployment.
- `strategy` (Attributes) Deployment strategy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--strategy))

<a id="nestedatt--data--strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.strategy`

Read-Only:

- `attributes` (Attributes) Strategy attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--strategy--attributes))
- `type` (String) Type of deployment strategy.

<a id="nestedatt--data--strategy--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.strategy.attributes`
